title: Zero-aeration algal-bacterial bioreactor for Yamuna water
meta: IIT Delhi Changemakers Bootcamp 2025, with Prof. Jay Dhariwal and Prof. Anushree Malik
description: A two-stage system pairs physical pre-filtration with an algal-bacterial consortium that makes its own oxygen, so no aeration is needed. It cut energy use an estimated 40 to 60% against activated sludge and brought nitrate under the WHO limit within 24 hours.
note: Selected for IIT Delhi Open House 2025 and featured in The Indian Express.
